description:
The CNPJ and address lookup service: today's free allowance, the single package, the three plans and your balance.
Without a credential, it shows the free allowance and the offers. With an account, credit (`X-Credito`) or an x402 wallet (`X-Wallet-Token`), it also shows the balance shared across Radar CNPJ, PontoFato and EditalMD. The wallet credential is issued separately on each portal.
